name: Subject pronouns: eu, tu, o senhor, vocês

ptBR.note: In Brazil você is the normal “you” for almost everyone, with the ele form of the verb; tu is regional. Chamo-me becomes Me chamo.

subtitle: Eu, tu, ele, ela, nós, vocês, eles, elas, plus o senhor / a senhora for a polite “you”. The verb ending already shows the person, so Portuguese often drops the pronoun: Moro em Lisboa.

concept.exampleHtml: Eu sou o Pedro. · Moro em Braga. · O senhor trabalha aqui? · Vocês são de Faro.

qa.html: tu is for one person you know well: friends, family, children, people your age. In Portugal many colleagues use tu at work too. The verb has its own form: falas, tens, és.

o senhor / a senhora is the polite “you”: older people, officials, a doctor, a customer. The verb is the same as for ele and ela: O senhor mora aqui? Often people just use the verb (Quer um café?) or the name (A Dona Fernanda está bem?). At Finanças, the Junta or the centro de saúde, use this form.

você also means “you”, with the ele form of the verb. You will hear it, but in Portugal it can sound distant or even rude to some people. Don't start with it: use tu or o senhor / a senhora. In Brazil você is the normal word.
vocês is “you” for two or more people, friends and strangers alike. The verb is the same as for eles: Vocês moram aqui? The old form vós is only in old texts and some regional speech.
The verb ending shows the person, so people often drop the pronoun: Falo inglês. Temos dois filhos. Use the pronoun for contrast or to be clear: Eu trabalho e ela estuda.
a gente is a casual “we”, with the ele form of the verb: A gente mora perto. = Nós moramos perto. eles is for men or mixed groups, elas only for women. There is no word for “it”: É grande.

concept.noteHtml: Common mistakes: ✗ Eu sou, eu moro, eu trabalho in every sentence → ✓ say eu once or not at all. ✗ Você quer um café? to an older stranger → ✓ O senhor quer um café? or just Quer um café? ✗ O senhor és… → ✓ O senhor é… For Spanish speakers: Portuguese tu has no accent and means “you”; “your” is teu.
